id: 01_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Introduction to Laboratory Safety
title: 实验室安全基础：实验室安全导论
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/01_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Introduction to Laboratory Safety.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/01_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Introduction to Laboratory Safety/src.py

points.K1: 实验室事故每年都在发生
points.K9: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the entrance of a bright laboratory building and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们一起走进实验室安全。

shots.scene: 事故、文化、责任、改进四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a yellow warning triangle, a heart inside a flask, linked hands, and a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 认识事故，建立文化，人人负责。

shots.scene: 阿杰披着长发、穿短袖实验服，兴冲冲走到台前
shots.prompt_en: The young male student with long loose hair, wearing a short-sleeved lab coat, cheerfully walks up to a lab bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰今天第一次进实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起移液器，满脸轻松
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a pipette with a relaxed, carefree face.
shots.narration: 他想：就做个小实验，能出什么事？

shots.scene: 欣欣从门边探出头，竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot leans in from the doorway and raises one finger with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 我们先看看，实验室里会出什么事。

shots.section_title: 实验室事故每年都在发生
shots.scene: 地球夜景图标，城市灯光点点，散布几个小警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A night view of the Earth from space with city lights, several small yellow warning triangles scattered over one continent. No people.
shots.narration: 在美国各地，实验室事故每年都在发生。
overlay: 实验室事故每年都在发生

shots.section_title: 实验室事故每年都在发生
shots.scene: 日历图标一页页翻过，每页都有一个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon flipping pages, each page showing a small warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 它并不罕见，年年都有。

shots.scene: 红色液滴溅开的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a red liquid drop splashing on a white surface. No people.
shots.narration: 有液体溢洒，

shots.scene: 针头图标滴下一滴红色液滴
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a syringe needle tip with a red drop falling from it. No people.
shots.narration: 有针刺伤，

shots.scene: 放大镜下的微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier icon over a cluster of cartoon microbes. No people.
shots.narration: 有实验室获得性感染，

shots.scene: 试剂柜图标闪红光，旁边是爆炸和火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A reagent cabinet icon flashing red, next to an explosion burst icon and a flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有化学品爆炸。

shots.scene: 一个小人图标旁出现黑色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram next to a dark warning triangle with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 严重的事故，甚至会造成死亡。

shots.scene: 阿杰长发散开、手臂外露，在台前用移液器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student with long loose hair and bare forearms uses a pipette at the bench, without goggles.
shots.narration: 事故最常发生在不守既定规范的时候。

shots.scene: 阿杰举起试管对着灯看，没戴护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a test tube up to the light to look at it, not wearing goggles.
shots.narration: 规范摆在那里，不遵守就容易出事。

shots.scene: 老周取出呼吸防护口罩，贴到脸上，拉好头带
shots.prompt_en: The older man in a white protective suit takes out a cup-shaped respirator, places it on his face and pulls the straps over his head.
shots.narration: 安全不是做完一次就算完成的目标。

shots.scene: 一条不断向上延伸的楼梯，没有终点
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon that keeps rising upward without an end, with a small flag on each step. No people.
shots.narration: 它是对安全文化的持续投入。

shots.scene: 循环箭头图标中间是一个烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow icon surrounding a flask with a heart inside. No people.
shots.narration: 要一直坚持，不断改进。

shots.scene: 实验室、人群和树木三个图标被一面盾牌护住
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon protecting three smaller icons: a lab room, a group of people, and a tree. No people.
shots.narration: 安全工作，为的是保护彼此、公众和环境。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套，往盖住溅洒的吸水纸上喷消毒液，再收拢
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves and goggles sprays disinfectant onto absorbent paper covering a small spill, then gathers it up.
shots.narration: 一处溢洒处理好，就护住了大家。

shots.scene: 老周坐在台前操作，没戴护目镜；小研走近提醒
shots.prompt_en: The older man works at a bench without safety goggles; the female graduate student walks over and politely reminds him.
shots.narration: 我们共同的责任：发现问题立即识别。

shots.scene: 老周笑着戴上护目镜，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The older man smiles, puts on safety goggles and gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 并且马上处理，不拖延。

shots.scene: 小研穿上防护服、扣好纽扣、戴上护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a protective gown, fastens the buttons and puts on safety goggles.
shots.narration: 每个人的安全，都取决于你的投入。

shots.scene: 一圈小人图标手拉手，围着中间的实验室图标
shots.prompt_en: A ring of person pictograms holding hands around a lab building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 强大的安全文化，要靠你来撑起。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜和手套，在安全柜前的夹板上记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves writes on a blank clipboard in front of a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 以可靠的风险评估为工作基础，

shots.scene: 老周双手按压口罩鼻夹，使口罩贴合
shots.prompt_en: The older man presses the nose clip of his respirator with both hands to seal it to his face.
shots.narration: 使用安全的操作方法和设备，

shots.scene: 老周和小研系围裙、戴面屏和低温手套，搬运液氮罐
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student, wearing aprons, face shields and cryogenic gloves, carry a liquid nitrogen dewar together.
shots.narration: 并且不断寻找更安全的做法，

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三人图标前，盾牌图标护住他们
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of three person icons protected by a shield icon.
shots.narration: 才能保护你、同事和身边的人。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本空白规程手册并排，规程手册更大
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 本课不能代替你实验室自己的规程。
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现警示三角和打叉的散发图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a warning triangle and a crossed-out loose hair icon.
shots.narration: 事故常有，多因不守规范。

shots.scene: 循环箭头和手拉手图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a circular arrow and linked hands. No people.
shots.narration: 安全文化要持续投入，人人有责。

shots.scene: 风险评估表、实验服、灯泡三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a blank checklist with a magnifier, a lab coat, and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 评估在先，规范操作，持续改进。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰一起向镜头挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye at the camera in front of the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 安全文化，从你我做起，下次见！
